summary: This clinical study tests a dietary supplement called Hebenrun combined with metformin for people with type 2 diabetes mellitus, which is a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar. The study has a status of Not yet recruiting and plans to enroll 110 participants. Jiangxi University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is the sponsor for this No phase trial. Participants will be divided into two groups to see how well they can stop taking other oral blood sugar medications.

facts.sponsor: Jiangxi University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
